out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: A review of the menu finds that the facility is producing grease in quantities likely to contribute to the production of grease-laden wastewater. Therefore, the wastewater from warewashing is required to go through a grease trap. OBSERVED NO GREASE TRAP INSTALLED SINCE MENTIONED AS REQUIRED DURING PREOCCUPANCY INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. OPERATORS ARE IN PROCESS OF INSTALLING GREASE TRAP. ENSURE AN AMENDMENT IN SUBMITTED IN PLUS FOR SCOPE OF WORK WITHIN 10 DAYS AND ENSURE BUILDING/PLUMBING APPLICATION HAS BEEN SUBMITTED. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP IN 30 DAYS TO VERIFY INSTALLATION OF GREASE TRAP.
